title: Base case of Frobenius/Zolotarev: sign(x ↦ a·x on ℤ/p) = (a/p)

insights: The whole-field sign equals the units sign because 0 is a fixed point of multiplication-by-a (Equiv.Perm.sign_subtypePerm): this fixed-point bridge is exactly the glue the parent oq-01-oq-03 named as its remaining step.
unitsEquivNeZero : (ℤ/p)ˣ ≃ {x : ℤ/p // x ≠ 0} identifies the nonzero-restriction of ringMulPerm a with the units permutation mulPerm a; sign_eq_sign_of_equiv transports the sign.

Units-level Zolotarev needs only two generator facts: a single (p-1)-cycle has sign -1 (p-1 even), and a generator of a cyclic group of even order is a non-square (orderOf u² = orderOf u / gcd(orderOf u,2)).
legendreSym p a is definitionally quadraticChar (ℤ/p) a, so the Legendre formulation follows from the quadratic-character one via a val-cast round-trip.
The grandparent ElementaryQuadraticReciprocityOQ01 is bit-rotted against Mathlib 4.26.0 (forward references + deprecations), so the units-level lemma had to be re-established self-contained.
